delete-description: “{{title}}” will be removed. Messages already sent are not changed.
empty-description: Keep the answers you give again and again, and add one to a message in a click.
limit-reached: You can keep up to {{max}} saved replies. Delete one to add another.
limits: Private to you. Up to {{max}} replies, a title of up to {{titleMax}} characters and text of up to {{bodyMax}}. Choosing one puts it in the message box; it is never sent for you.
load-failed: Could not load your saved replies
name-hint: becomes the other person’s name in a direct message.
no-room: That reply does not fit in the message.
